# bugs #3920: Ascon tests: four implementations still fail on stm8, and two guards disable cases that pass

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3920/
- Category: [Analyzed, not fixed](../../unresolved.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Keep open. Four implementations still fail on stm8. Recheck the guards for opt32_lowsize on stm8 and for AEAD bi8 on z80.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The compile failure of the second comment does not occur on r17176. The construct, an inline
function that applies `^=` through two post-incremented pointer parameters, compiles for mcs51
without error 20.

The runtime failures were checked for mcs51, z80, and stm8. Each case of `asconhash256.c.in` and
`asconaead128.c.in` was built as one program, without the guards that disable it for lack of
memory or with a reference to this ticket. A replacement for `testfwk.h` counts the assertions
and the failures, and the program ran in ucsim. The regression makefile was not used. AEAD
decryption was not run.

| Port | Hash | AEAD encryption |
|---|---|---|
| stm8 | `ref` and `opt32_lowsize` pass. `opt8`, `opt8_lowsize`, `opt8_mylowsize`, and `bi8` fail one of two assertions. | `ref` and `opt32_lowsize` pass. `opt8`, `opt8_lowsize`, and `opt8_mylowsize` fail one of three assertions. `bi8` gave no result. |
| z80 | `bi8` and `opt8_mylowsize` pass. | `bi8` and `opt8_mylowsize` pass. |
| mcs51, large model | All six implementations pass. | `ref` passes. The other five do not link. |

For `bi8` on stm8 the simulator stopped at an invalid instruction after 64 clock ticks, and the
cause was not examined. For mcs51 the linker finds no room in internal RAM for the `DSEG` or
`OSEG` area of the five AEAD programs.

## Known

[r16072](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/16072/) fixed the compile failure, as the third
comment says. It changed how `src/SDCCast.c` creates and declares the temporary variables of an
inlined call, and the identifier in the error message is the name of such a variable. It also added
`support/regression/tests/bug-3920.c`.

On r17176 both tests disable the five implementations other than `ref` for big-endian targets,
with a reference to this ticket. `asconaead128.c.in` also disables `bi8` for every SDCC target.
Two of these guards cover cases that pass here: `opt32_lowsize` on stm8, for the hash and for AEAD
encryption, and `bi8` on z80 for AEAD encryption.

Both tests are disabled for mcs51 for lack of memory. The hash test links and passes in the large
model.

## Open

Every failure found is on stm8, the only big-endian port that was built. Whether the cause is in
SDCC or in the byte order handling of the Ascon sources, which the fourth comment suspects, was
not determined. The other big-endian ports and mos6502, which the last comment names, were not
built.
